registry.name: Unified in-file search
registry.title: Unified in-file search
registry.description: Custom unified search overlay working across Editor and all preview types (Markdown Preview, future HTML/SVG previews). Identical visual appearance and keyboard shortcuts regardless of view mode. Extensible architecture for future preview types.

registry.name: Editor context menu with prompts
registry.description: Add context menu with AI prompts to Monaco editor triggered on text selection. Mirrors existing preview context menu UX and shares prompt execution infrastructure, but with editor-specific prompt set.

registry.name: Real-time git status refresh
registry.description: Bullet-proof, real-time git status refresh mechanism for Project panel that detects all change scenarios (internal edits, external git CLI, external file changes, network/cloud sync) within <1 second latency, with polling fallback for guaranteed reliability.
